# Connect UnifAPI to OpenClaw

> One-command plugin — skills + MCP · read-only public-data MCP over OAuth — **eyes, not hands**.

Connect OpenClaw to the UnifAPI public-data MCP server and run marketing research — SEO, AI-visibility (GEO), social, local, and competitive intelligence — from live public data without leaving OpenClaw. A one-command plugin — it installs the marketing-agent skills and the public-data MCP server together. One OAuth sign-in, no API key to paste; everything is read-only.

## Steps

### 1. Add the marketplace

In your agent, run:

```text
/plugin marketplace add unifapi-agent/agents
```

### 2. Install the plugin

```text
/plugin install unifapi@unifapi
```

One install brings the marketing-agent skills and the public-data MCP server together.

### 3. Sign in with OAuth

OpenClaw opens a browser sign-in for your UnifAPI workspace. Read-only — no API key to paste.

### 4. Try it with OpenClaw

```text
Use UnifAPI to pull the current top Hacker News story and summarize it.
```
